shortBio.en: MBV guitar/vocals; soft blend with Shields low in the Loveless mix.
shortBio.zh: MBV 吉他/人声；与 Shields 在 Loveless 混音低处柔声交融。

body.en:
Born 1961. Joins late 1980s; dual guitar/vocal with Shields on Isn’t Anything and Loveless. Soft delivery buried in harmonic fog defines the blend.

Peak citation is the Loveless-era four.
body.zh:
1961 年生。80 年代末加入；在 Isn’t Anything 与 Loveless 上与 Shields 双吉他/人声。柔声埋在和声雾中定义交融。

峰值引用是 Loveless 时期四人组。
